title: Cancellation - Order Cancellation Policy
content: # Order Cancellation Policy

title: Cancellation - 1. Cancellation Before Dispatch
content:
## 1. Cancellation Before Dispatch
- Customers can cancel an order free of charge at any time before it has been dispatched from our fulfillment warehouse.
- To cancel an order before dispatch:
  1. Go to **My Orders**.
  2. Select the relevant order.
  3. Click **Cancel Order** and select a cancellation reason.
- For prepaid orders cancelled prior to dispatch, the full refund is initiated automatically within **2 hours**, and funds are credited back to the original payment source within **24 to 48 hours** for UPI/Wallets or **3 to 5 business days** for credit/debit cards.

title: Cancellation - 2. Cancellation After Dispatch
content:
## 2. Cancellation After Dispatch
- If the order has already been shipped or is in transit, it cannot be cancelled directly through the website or mobile app.
- In this case, customers have two options:
  - **Refuse delivery** when the courier delivery agent attempts doorstep delivery.
  - **Accept delivery** and initiate a 7-day return through the standard return portal.
- Once the package is marked as returned to sender (RTO), a full refund will be processed minus any expedited shipping charges.

title: Cancellation - 3. Merchant / System Cancellations
content:
## 3. Merchant / System Cancellations
We reserve the right to cancel an order under the following exceptional circumstances:
- The ordered product is unexpectedly out of stock or fails final pre-dispatch quality inspection.
- The delivery address is incomplete, unserviceable, or falls outside our courier coverage zones.
- Flagged fraudulent transactions or pricing errors due to system glitches.
- In such cases, customers will be notified immediately via email and SMS, and a 100% full refund will be issued immediately.

title: Delivery - Delivery and Shipping Information
content: # Delivery and Shipping Information

title: Delivery - 1. Shipping Options and Timelines
content:
## 1. Shipping Options and Timelines
We deliver to over 19,000 postal pincodes across India through premier courier partners (BlueDart, Delhivery, DTDC, and India Post).

- **Standard Delivery**: 
  - Estimated delivery within **3 to 5 business days** for metro cities and tier-1 locations.
  - **4 to 7 business days** for tier-2, tier-3, and remote locations.
  - Delivery is **FREE** on all orders above ₹999. A flat nominal shipping fee of ₹49 applies to orders under ₹999.
- **Express / Next-Day Delivery**:
  - Available in select metropolitan cities (Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune).
  - Orders placed before 1:00 PM are dispatched on the same day and delivered within **24 to 48 hours**.
  - Flat fee of ₹99 applies regardless of cart value.

title: Delivery - 2. Order Tracking
content:
## 2. Order Tracking
- Once your order is dispatched from our warehouse, you will receive an automated email and SMS notification containing the Courier Partner Name and AWB Tracking Number.
- You can track your package in real-time by visiting **My Orders > Track Shipment** or directly on the courier partner's tracking portal.

title: Delivery - 3. Delivery Attempts and Verification
content:
## 3. Delivery Attempts and Verification
- Our delivery executives will make up to **3 delivery attempts** before returning the package to our warehouse.
- For high-value electronics and smartphones (orders exceeding ₹10,000), a secure **OTP (One-Time Password)** will be sent to your registered mobile number for verification at the time of delivery.
- Please do not share the OTP until you have physically verified the intact condition of the outer shipping box. If the outer package appears tampered or open, refuse delivery immediately.

title: Faq - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
content: # Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

title: Faq - 1. General Ordering & Account Questions
content:
## 1. General Ordering & Account Questions

### How do I check my order status?
You can check your order status anytime by logging into your account and clicking on **My Orders**. Click on the specific order to view current progress (Processing, Packed, Dispatched, Out for Delivery, Delivered) and live courier tracking.

### Can I modify my shipping address after placing an order?
You can edit your delivery address directly from the **My Orders** screen as long as the order has not been dispatched. Once dispatched, addresses cannot be altered in transit due to courier security constraints.

### How do I get an official GST tax invoice?
Every shipped order automatically generates a GST-compliant tax invoice. Go to **My Orders > Order Details > Download Invoice (PDF)**.

title: Faq - 2. Customer Support & Contact Timings
content:
## 2. Customer Support & Contact Timings

### How can I reach human customer support?
- **Email Support**: `support@shopease.com` (24-48 hour response time)
- **Toll-Free Helpline**: `1800-123-4567` (Available Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST)
- **Live In-App Chat**: Available 24/7 with this AI Assistant, with instant escalation options to human agents during operational business hours.

### Where are your fulfillment centers located?
Our state-of-the-art warehouses are located in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, and Kolkata, enabling rapid same-day and next-day delivery across India.

### Are genuine products and warranties guaranteed?
Yes! 100% of products sold on our platform are sourced directly from authorized brand distributors and official brand partners. All items come with brand warranty and authentic manufacturer packaging.

title: Payment - Payment Information and Methods
content: # Payment Information and Methods

title: Payment - 1. Supported Payment Options
content:
## 1. Supported Payment Options
We provide secure, encrypted 256-bit SSL checkout supporting the following payment methods:
- **UPI**: Instant payment via Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, and all bank UPI apps with zero transaction surcharge.
- **Credit and Debit Cards**: Visa, MasterCard, RuPay, Maestro, and American Express cards issued by all major domestic and international banks.
- **Net Banking**: Direct bank transfer supported for 50+ banks across India (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis, Kotak, etc.).
- **EMI & Pay Later**:
  - No-Cost EMI and Standard Credit Card EMI available on orders above ₹3,000 for tenures of 3, 6, 9, and 12 months.
  - Debit Card EMI and Cardless EMI available through partner providers.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD)**:
  - COD is available on orders between ₹299 and ₹20,000 for serviceable pincodes.
  - A nominal ₹30 handling charge is applicable for COD orders. Exact cash or QR code scan-on-delivery is accepted.

title: Payment - 2. Payment Security and Encryption
content:
## 2. Payment Security and Encryption
- All transactions are processed through PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant payment gateways.
- We never store customer CVVs, credit/debit card numbers, or banking PINs on our servers.
- Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / OTP) is mandatory for all card transactions.

title: Payment - 3. Failed or Pending Payments
content:
## 3. Failed or Pending Payments
- In the event of a transaction failure where money was debited from your bank account but no order confirmation was generated:
  - The payment gateway will automatically initiate a refund within **24 hours**.
  - Banks typically take **2 to 5 business days** to credit the amount back to your account.
  - If the amount is not reversed after 5 business days, please share the transaction reference ID (UTR number) with our customer support team for manual reconciliation.

title: Return Refund - Return and Refund Policy
content: # Return and Refund Policy

title: Return Refund - 1. Return Window and Eligibility
content:
## 1. Return Window and Eligibility
- Customers can return products within **7 days** of delivery for eligible items.
- To be eligible for a return, items must be in their original, unused condition, with all original tags, user manuals, warranty cards, and intact packaging.
- Electronics (Smartphones, Laptops, Keyboards, Audio Devices) must be factory reset with all personal accounts removed.
- Defective, damaged, or incorrect items received must be reported within **48 hours** of delivery with unboxing photos or video evidence.

title: Return Refund - 2. Non-Returnable Items
content:
## 2. Non-Returnable Items
The following items cannot be returned unless received in a damaged or defective condition:
- Opened software, digital codes, or downloadable products.
- Consumable items where the hygienic seal has been broken (e.g., in-ear earbuds ear-tips, cleaning cloths).
- Products marked as "Final Sale" or "Clearance".
- Items returned without serial numbers, original invoice, or with damaged manufacturer barcodes.

title: Return Refund - 3. Return Process
content:
## 3. Return Process
1. Navigate to **My Orders** in your account dashboard and click **Request Return**.
2. Select the reason for return and upload supporting photographs if the product is damaged or defective.
3. Our courier partner will schedule a doorstep quality check and pickup within **2 to 3 business days**.
4. Once the returned item reaches our fulfillment center and passes inspection (1-2 days), the refund will be triggered immediately.

title: Return Refund - 4. Refund Methods and Timelines
content:
## 4. Refund Methods and Timelines
Refunds will be processed back to the original payment method according to the following schedule:
- **UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm)**: 24 to 48 hours after return verification.
- **Credit / Debit Cards**: 3 to 7 business days depending on the issuing bank.
- **Net Banking**: 3 to 5 business days.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Refund will be credited via NEFT / IMPS bank transfer or instant Store Wallet Credit within 2 business days after the customer provides their bank details.
- **Shipping Fees**: Standard shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to a merchant error (defective or wrong item delivered).

title: Warranty - Product Warranty Policy
content: # Product Warranty Policy

title: Warranty - 1. Standard Brand Warranty
content:
## 1. Standard Brand Warranty
- All electronic products (Smartphones, Laptops, Keyboards, Audio Devices, Smart Watches, PC Peripherals) sold on our platform carry a minimum **1-Year Manufacturer Brand Warranty** from the date of invoice.
- Selected premium components and backpacks carry extended manufacturer warranties:
  - Backpacks and Travel Gear: **2-Year Limited Stitch & Zipper Warranty**.
  - Laptop mechanical switches / keyboard switches: **1-Year Limited Replacement Guarantee**.

title: Warranty - 2. What Is Covered Under Warranty?
content:
## 2. What Is Covered Under Warranty?
- Manufacturing defects in materials and craftsmanship.
- Hardware failure under normal recommended operating conditions.
- Sensor, battery, or motherboard malfunctions not caused by external trauma or abuse.
- Dead-on-arrival (DOA) units reported within 48 hours of initial delivery.

title: Warranty - 3. What Is Excluded From Warranty?
content:
## 3. What Is Excluded From Warranty?
- Physical damage, drops, cracks, dents, and accidental liquid/water immersion (unless certified IP rating explicitly covers it).
- Wear and tear resulting from routine daily usage (scratches on display, fabric fraying, normal cosmetic wear).
- Unauthorized disassembly, modifications, unofficial firmware flashing, or repairs conducted by third-party technicians.
- Damage caused by electrical surges, faulty wall sockets, or non-certified third-party charging cables.

title: Warranty - 4. How to Claim Warranty
content:
## 4. How to Claim Warranty
1. Locate your tax invoice in your account under **My Orders > Download Invoice**.
2. Visit any authorized manufacturer brand service center across India with the original invoice and product serial number.
3. Alternatively, contact our dedicated warranty desk at `warranty@shopease.com` or call `1800-123-4567` for doorstep warranty pickup in select metro cities.
